title: Katie Zacharia is out as press secretary, White House says
content: Katie Zacharia is "transitioning out" of her role as press secretary, according to a White House official not authorized to speak on the record, marking a stunning turn of events for the spokeswoman.

title: Hot flashes, night sweats, insomnia – OB-GYNS set new rules for menopause treatment
content: For the first time since 2014, the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists has updated its guidelines for the treatment of symptoms commonly associated with menopause.

title: Amid talk of public execution, public opinion on death penalty is split
content: A majority of Americans support the death penalty for people convicted of murder, but support becomes more divided when questions vary.

title: Israeli settlers beat Palestinians and a U.S. photojournalist in West Bank attacks
content: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians as they were harvesting olives in the occupied West Bank on Friday, injuring several people including a photojournalist working for The Washington Post.

title: Crowds throng New Delhi and wave Indian flags amid escalating protests
content: Protests have intensified over a review of voter lists that critics say is politically motivated and threatens to disenfranchise voters. The Election Commission and Modi's administration deny these allegations.

title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
content: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

title: Teen kills 4 at Oregon school. And, DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizens
content: A teen opened fire at an Oregon elementary school, leaving three kids and one teacher dead. And, the Justice Department is suing California over alleged noncitizen voters.

title: What this bankruptcy says about AI startups
content: Character.AI collected millions of users, making it a very appealing acquisition. Google took a unique route to "acquiring" it, hiring away its founders and licensing its technology. Now Character.AI is filing for bankruptcy. Here's what to know.
